NEXT_ACTION: <one concrete next action>
RATIONALE: <one concise sentence>

raw_text:
NEXT_ACTION: Begin by importing a subset of the oldest legacy format records using the scripted import to identify and address any encoding issues before proceeding with the full migration.

RATIONALE: This approach allows us to troubleshoot potential problems with the oldest legacy format records in a controlled manner, ensuring that the integrity of these records is preserved before moving forward with the entire migration process.
